pr_title: feat(video): cute-cartoon and cute-mystery join the explainer family on tools, API and web; flat-explainer does not move
summary:
WORK ORDER, pull request 1 of 3 for tasks/open/2026-10-10-explainer-route-takes-a-series-look.md. Designed against 599835f49502831922fe31a1bcb9bf4429c0acff; nothing in the repository was changed. Paths are repository-relative because they must be read at that commit (the checkout at <repo> is on another branch) and because bound_files_touched has to match the keys of REVIEW_FILES. Notes, the measured values and a scratch prototype are in <scratch>\explainer\pr1-presets\ (NOTES.md, proto.diff.txt, probe.proto.json).

WHAT THIS PULL REQUEST DOES. The two presets exist in PRESETS (tools), STYLE_PRESETS / StylePreset and three CHECK constraints (API, migration 0129) and the web type and labels. "Is an explainer" is split from "whose identity": every site gets one of two helpers and no bare string comparison is left. No prompt, payload, image-model or request-form change.

THE TWO HELPERS (tools/video/core/drama.mjs, beside EXPLAINER_PRESET).
- FAMILY: `EXPLAINER_PRESETS = ["flat-explainer", "cute-cartoon", "cute-mystery"]` and `isExplainerPreset(preset)` for a preset name (request, series row, saved state); the existing `isExplainer(doc)` is built on it. True for all three: narrator only, all stills, no cast, 8 to 20 minutes with default 10, the 480-second measured floor, the question-shaped bible and brief, the explainer card list, the "explainer" and "bible-explainer" prompt variants.
- IDENTITY: `explainerSeries(doc)` returns "sothatswhy" for a drama in flat-explainer or cute-cartoon and null otherwise (cute-mystery included). Read by core/branding.mjs (bookends), render/plan.mjs thumbnailSeries (series thumbnail, its pillar tag classes, the 10x2 headline rule; lint and qa follow through thumbnailSeries) and shorts/episode.mjs (Shorts series). With null a cute-mystery video takes the channel bookends, the channel "thumb" layout with the six-character headline rule, and Shorts of series "illustrated", which is what the three local pilots have.
- API mirror: `EXPLAINER_PRESETS` tuple and `is_explainer_preset()` in schemas.py; the single constant EXPLAINER_PRESET is removed there (only series.py imported it). Web mirror: `EXPLAINER_PRESETS` and `isExplainerPreset` in admin-video-settings.tsx. The API and the web have no identity site.

RECOMMENDATION ON THE REQUEST FORM: keep both presets OUT of the request form until pull request 3. API and tools accept them, the labels ship, the form's four comparisons use the family helper, but REQUEST_PRESETS stays at five values and a test pins that. Pull request 3 adds the two names to that one array. Reason, measured on the prototype: a cute-* request filed before pull request 3 is planned and written by So That's Why's "bible-explainer" and "explainer" prompts (the writer is told `"look": {"preset": "flat-explainer"}`, "no mascot or recurring character", "anonymous figures"; settle() then forces the request's preset, so the chibi style text is put behind scene prompts written for flat anonymous figures). Before pull request 2 its series row has no image_model, so it is drawn by the drama settings' model (per the ticket Gemini 3 Pro, US$0.134 a picture in the catalog against US$0.0035 for image-01), at 2K. A cute-cartoon video otherwise completes with So That's Why's identity. A cute-mystery video is additionally briefed for So That's Why's thumbnail while it wears the channel's: `layout: "right"` is refused by render ("thumbnail.data.layout must be one of a, b, c"), a headline of more than six counted characters fails QA's thumbnail item after narration and pictures are paid for, and its tag is one of 商業／科學／旅遊／科技. After pull request 2 the picture cost is right and the rest is the same. Nothing of this can be filed from the site while the form does not offer the presets; only a direct API call by the owner could.
